_comment: A team's LAST unit routs, without instantly losing. Stages team 0's ONLY unit -- a full-strength (120) but shaken (morale 10) player infantry -- meeting a single, slightly larger enemy infantry (130) head-on. Both blocks are pinned to Tight (formation 1) so packed files still produce the rout inside this clip. Sustained frontal casualties and being outnumbered (the local force ratio, 120 to 130) erode its morale to 0 (#529), and it breaks and flees (faded) while barely bloodied. It used to trigger instant defeat + a paused freeze the moment its last fightable unit left the line; now the battle stays live while it's routing. Routing units are still valid combat targets, and the enemy follows it in its ranks as it flees. Each routed man runs on his own from the enemy he sees toward his own back edge (SoldierFlightStep), and the unit's position is the centroid of its men. Measured with dense 2-tick FULL dumps on its own seed (seed 0), 2026-11-13 on #1949's branch: FIGHTING at tick 950, ROUTING from tick 976 at (785.94, 507.15), out of contact by tick 1000, and still ROUTING at tick 1300, the clip's end, at (655.4, 270.13) (pinned, tol 5 wu), 270 wu from where it broke, fleeing north-west. The pin was (787.65, 197.42) for the old flight's couple() anchor (#1825), which the bottom-up flight (#1949) removed. On perturbed seeds 1 to 4 this staging breaks at different ticks (seeds 2 to 4 are still FIGHTING at tick 1000, as on main), so the tick-1000 state and tick-1300 position pins hold on the clip's own seed; on main c36560fa the old pin likewise failed on seeds 1 to 4. STAGING (#1827): blocks front to front now meet at their front ranks, so only the front ranks trade blows, and against an equal 120 it no longer broke reliably inside the clip. This clip only needs to show the rout starting and the battle staying live through it, not the whole grind. No player input needed.

follow_error.reason: follow_error, the relational successor of shape_residual, reads uid1 24.55 against 6.75 on this tree (dense 2-tick FULL dump, Windows, seed 0, measured 2026-11-13); the slot-based shape_residual this exemption was written against read uid1 22.9. Original reason: The pursuer (uid 1) chases the router with its grid still scrambled from the fight: its slot residual reads 12 to 16 wu while in contact (not judged) and 19 to 21 wu once contact breaks, against 6.75. Measured 2026-11-10 on aef5b476, seeds 0 to 4. On dense 2-tick FULL dumps over ticks 2 to 1400, every exemption removed, the verdict FAILS on seeds 0, 1, 3 and 4 (worst 22.9, 27.2, 38 and 24.2) and passes on seed 2 (0.00171). On the clip's own declared ticks (950, 1000, 1300) it passes on every seed (worst 0), so there the exemption reads STALE. Kept because it fires on four of five seeds on dense dumps. The same deformation in pursuit reads 25.2 on merge-base a3714751's own staging (2-tick samples), where it does not last long enough to fail the check; this staging breaks earlier (#1827). #1824 tracks a pursuer deforming at the edge of a router's contact range.
